tests.name: App: responds to simple request
tests.setup: gem install bundler -v 1.15.3 --no-document && bundle _1.15.3_ install --without production && gem install rspec -v 3.10.0 --no-document && gem install nokogiri -v 1.12.5 --no-document && gem install connection_pool -v 2.5.5 --no-document && gem install net-http-persistent -v 4.0.1 --no-document && gem install mechanize -v 2.8.2 --no-document && RAILS_ENV=development bundle _1.15.3_ exec rake db:setup && RAILS_ENV=development bundle _1.15.3_ exec rake db:migrate && bundle _1.15.3_ exec rails server -e development -p 3000 -d && for i in {1..60}; do curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:3000/movies >/dev/null && break; sleep 2; done
tests.run: HEROKU_URI=127.0.0.1:3000 ruby -S rspec .github/classroom/director_spec.rb -e "responds to simple request"
